decisions.decision: FULL AUDIT COVERAGE SHIPPED -- principal-granted single exception to the doctrine freeze, on the finding that the desk's audit COVERAGE was ~1% and structurally biased. Problem (measured, not asserted): the 13-model panel received ONLY docs/EXTERNAL_PANEL_DOSSIER.md -- 11,337 bytes of prose -- against 451 source files / ~43,782 lines; the dossier is authored by the system under audit, so the auditee was selecting the auditor's evidence and anything omitted could never be flagged. Today's own incident proved the mechanism: the panel overturned the CRO's wrong 'modest slippage' diagnosis ONLY because the incident dossier was explicitly scoped to it. BUILT: scripts/build_audit_coverage.py (stdlib-only) + run_external_panel.py wiring so every panel run additionally carries (A) the RAW UNFILTERED git diff since the previous panel -- curation-proof by construction, (B) a rotating slice of the LEAST-RECENTLY-AUDITED source in full (200k-char budget ~= <$1/run across 13 seats; ~8-12 runs per complete sweep), ordered risk-path-staleness first, and (C) the coverage manifest itself, with an explicit instruction that 'I could not verify X because file Y was not provided' is a first-class finding -- models are asked to name their own blind spots. LEDGER: data/audit_coverage.json tracks per-file last_audited / audit_count / tier, with STALENESS FLOORS (risk-path 14d, everything else 30d), making full coverage a measurable property instead of an aspiration. Brain contract gains an AUDIT COVERAGE DUTY: never-audited and past-floor files are DEFECTS to name in the cycle report, and a stale risk-path file fires an OFF-ROTATION panel rather than waiting for cadence. SAFETY: data/secrets/** and key/credential-shaped paths excluded before read; the assembled payload passes through the desk's own sanitize() and returns EMPTY rather than send if the sanitizer is unavailable; coverage failure can never kill a panel run (try/except, dossier-only fallback). HONEST RESIDUE: (a) GAP #27 stands -- the automated growth audit still checks only capital-utilization + leverage, so conservatism on exploration/validation/breadth surfaces remains judged narratively; (b) a full sweep takes ~8-12 panel runs (~1 month at 3-day cadence), so coverage climbs toward 100% rather than arriving at it tonight -- the manifest reports the true percentage every cycle; (c) risk-path code still lacks the connector spec's mutation-testing + second-model-family breaker bar, which is separate and still open. NEIGHBOURS: panel runner (payload grows -- OpenRouter spend up ~$0.50-1.00/run, inside the quoted envelope), sanitize() (now the gate on source, not just prose), panel context budgets (200k chars fits every flagship seat's window), micro-audit (unchanged, complements this), doctrine freeze (single principal-granted exception; connector remains priority #1 for 07-31).

decisions.expected_benefit: every file judged by 13 cold minds within its staleness floor; blind spots become nameable findings; coverage % is reportable each cycle

decisions.decision: PRINCIPAL STANDING DIRECTIVE: no degradation for cost, ever. Quality, coverage, cadence, model tier and breadth are never reduced to save money; when spend binds, the desk PAGES with the exact number and ask rather than quietly shrinking itself or pitching cheaper-but-worse options as recommendations. Made constitutional. This RETROACTIVELY WITHDRAWS the three 'cheaper alternatives' the CRO offered in tonight's purchase page (weekly cadence, smaller rotating budget, dropping the 3 priciest seats) -- they were honest options but the principal's standing answer is no: he funds the configuration, the CRO keeps it whole and states true cost. Principal will fund Friday 2026-07-24. COROLLARY BUILT (outage != degradation): data/secrets/llm_panel_free.json -- a 4-seat FREE emergency roster (nemotron-3-ultra:free at 1M ctx, tencent/hy3:free, cohere/north-mini-code:free, nemotron-nano-reasoning:free). When credits are unfunded the panel now runs these instead of aborting, and stamps the inbox header DEGRADED RUN -- FREE SEATS ONLY so the brain never treats weak findings as full-roster consensus and re-runs anything structural once funded. Zero external review for four days was the worse option; a labelled weak review is not a cost-saving choice, it is outage resilience, and the full roster resumes automatically the moment funds land (no manual restore, nothing left parked at the fallback). NEIGHBOURS: pre-flight credit check (now falls back rather than exits), panel inbox consumers (must honour the DEGRADED header), coverage ledger (free-run credits still require the same substantive-response quorum, so a weak run cannot inflate coverage), purchase-page policy (unchanged and now first-firing-proven).
decisions.hypothesis: funding the true configuration beats optimising it downward; labelled fallback beats silence during outages
decisions.expected_benefit: no silent quality erosion; audits continue through the 4-day funding gap; principal always sees true cost
decisions.expected_cost: higher steady-state spend, ~$15-25/mo, accepted by the principal
assumptions: free seats accept the ~250k coverage payload -- unverified, they may blank; the DEGRADED label covers that honestly
decisions.success_metric: zero cost-motivated config reductions in the ledger; full roster restored automatically post-funding
decisions.reversal_condition: n/a -- principal directive; only he can relax it
